decisions.title: New Mexico Prioritized Statewide Bicycle Network Plan
decisions.description: Identifies a prioritized bicycle network on NMDOT highways, classifies routes by investment tier, and provides facility guidance for incorporating safer bikeways during reconstruction and rehabilitation projects.

decisions.title: New Mexico Prioritized Statewide Bicycle Network Plan Appendix
decisions.description: Documents the plan's highway tables, demand and equity analyses, statewide maps, public survey findings, and agency responses supporting the prioritized bicycle network.

decisions.title: NMDOT Complete Streets Strategic Plan
decisions.description: Sets NMDOT's statewide framework for routinely planning, designing, funding, constructing, operating, and maintaining transportation facilities that safely serve people walking, bicycling, using transit, driving, and moving freight.
decisions.large_file_assessment: The exact file is 49,888,383 bytes (47.58 MiB), unusually large because its 114 pages contain extensive photographs, diagrams, maps, and designed layouts. It is an authoritative PDF; no smaller authoritative version was found. Optimization is technically possible but would alter the preserved source and is unnecessary for usefulness. Projected R2 storage after the full batch is 3,233,139,359 bytes.

decisions.title: New Mexico 2045 Plan
decisions.description: Establishes New Mexico's statewide long-range transportation direction through 2045, connecting safety, asset management, mobility, multimodal access, economic vitality, environmental stewardship, performance measures, and investment strategies.

decisions.title: NMDOT Carbon Reduction Strategy
decisions.description: Defines statewide strategies and eligible investments for reducing transportation emissions through cleaner vehicles, traffic operations, transit, active transportation, travel-demand management, freight efficiency, and resilient infrastructure.

decisions.title: NMDOT Resilience Improvement Plan
decisions.description: Assesses climate and natural-hazard risks to New Mexico transportation infrastructure, identifies vulnerable corridors and assets, and establishes resilience strategies, project priorities, and federal PROTECT funding eligibility.

decisions.title: New Mexico Strategic Highway Safety Plan
decisions.description: Sets New Mexico's statewide roadway-safety priorities and Safe System strategies, covering impaired driving, speeding, intersections, lane departures, pedestrians, bicyclists, motorcyclists, occupant protection, data, and emergency response.

decisions.title: NMDOT Vulnerable Road User Safety Assessment
decisions.description: Analyzes pedestrian and bicyclist fatalities and serious injuries statewide, identifies high-risk areas and contributing factors, and recommends infrastructure, policy, data, education, enforcement, and funding actions.

decisions.title: Incident Management Plan for the Albuquerque Metropolitan Planning Area
decisions.description: Coordinates Albuquerque-area traffic-incident detection, emergency response, communications, traveler information, alternate routes, clearance practices, performance measures, training, and interagency roles through a shared regional framework.

decisions.title: NMDOT Functional Classification System Guide
decisions.description: Explains New Mexico roadway functional classifications, why classifications matter, how boundaries are determined, agency responsibilities, review cycles, and procedures for requesting classification changes.
